notes.title: FREEZEFRAME... out now!
notes.content: We're so excited to announce that FREEZEFRAME is out right now!

notes.title: FREEZEFRAME is coming early!
notes.content: FREEZEFRAME is coming early by a few days. We now plan to release on the 27th of December, which is pretty freaking sweet if you ask us!

notes.title: Prerelease Update 1.0
notes.content:
15/12/2021 09:48
FREEZEFRAME has received a small update, changes are:

- Based on feedback from beta testers and curator reviews, I have upped the movement speed of the player. Whilst overall the movement speed has been increased, there is a level in the game where movement hasn't increased as much as others, this is to ensure the puzzle and overall level still work as speed is a factor in said level.

Thanks so much,
Alex

notes.title: FREEZEFRAME... Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello!

FREEZEFRAME is a short 3D Puzzle Platformer game where you use your magic, teleporting camera to escape a museum that you're locked inside.

Coming to Steam on December the 31st, FREEZEFRAME costs $1.99/£1.50/€1.75 with a whopping 30% discount at launch.

While you wait for release, wishlist FREEZEFRAME so you know when it's out and check out our socials for behind the scenes, cool insights and rambles.
